tools.name: ask_business
tools.description:
Ask the store a question about its policies and services: returns, refunds and exchanges, shipping and delivery, privacy, terms, subscriptions, contact details and opening hours, or FAQ topics such as gift wrapping. The store answers it: from its own knowledge base when the store offers Ask, otherwise from its published policies, FAQ pages and articles. Put the shopper's question in ask.query in their own words, one question per call; name the topic when the shopper only implies it (e.g. a question about sending back a gift is a returns question). Read-only: it does not change the cart, place orders, or start returns. For products, prices and availability, use search_catalog or get_product.
Examples of questions:
  - What is your return policy?
  - How long does shipping to Canada take?
  - What is your phone number?
  - What are your hours of operation?
  - Do you offer gift wrapping?

tools.name: browse_store
tools.description: Browse OR navigate to store collections. Set navigate=true whenever the user wants to be taken to a collection page in the browser (triggers: "browse to", "go to", "show me", "open", "take me to", "navigate to" a collection or category). With navigate=false (default), returns collection or product data without changing the page — use this only when the user is asking a question about the catalog, not asking to view it. Without a collection handle, lists all collections. With a handle, returns products from that collection; use "all" to browse everything. Does NOT add anything to the cart; use create_cart or update_cart for cart changes. Prefer this over search_catalog when the user names a category, collection, or wants to explore. With navigate=true this MOVES the browser to the collection page; the tool result confirms the destination, and no further navigation is needed to show it.

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Remove all items from the cart in one step. Use when the user wants to empty their cart or start over.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create the shopper's cart with the given items, for a shopper whose cart has no items yet. It is the tool for a shopper asking to add or buy something when the cart is empty, and that request is all the authorization it needs. Each line item names a ProductVariant GID in item.id (variant_id from search_catalog or browse_store, or variants[].id from get_product for specific options) and a quantity; every item from one request fits in one call. When the cart already has items, nothing is created or changed: the result is that existing cart with an error message, and update_cart can extend it with its current lines plus the new ones. Returns the whole resulting cart, including its id and line ids. Repeating a call with the same items leaves the cart as it is.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Get the shopper's current cart: its id, every line (line id, product and variant titles, variant id, handle, URL, image, unit price, quantity, line price) and the totals. Everything needed to describe the cart to the user in natural language, without a follow-up get_product call per line. It is also where a change to an existing cart starts from: update_cart takes the cart's id and the complete set of lines the cart should hold, and create_cart applies only to a cart with no items. Works from any page.
